title: Trading and settlement of trades in dematerialised securities
text: SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT Mittal Court, A Wing, Gr. Floor, 224, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400 021 SMDRP/POLCIY/CIR-27/2000 JULY 12, 2000 To: All Stock Exchanges/Depositories/ Custodians and AMFI/RAIN Dear Sirs, Trading and settlement of trades in dematerialised securities. Please refer to our earlier circular no. SMDRP/Policy/Cir-23/2000 dated May 29, 2000 advising inter-alia the list of 300 scrips (serial numbers 1 to 300 of annexure "A" to the circular) for compulsory settlement of trades in dematerialised form for all investors with effect from July 24, 2000. Some of the companies, whose scrips were included in the list of securities for compulsory trading in dematerialised form for all investors, could not sign agreements and establish connectivity with either or both the depositories well on time or are in the process of doing so. It has been decided that the effective date for compulsory trading by all investors in dematerialised form for these scrips (39 scrips as per annexure A) therefore stands postponed and the revised date would be announced later. Yours faithfully, P. K.
